CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_onboarding (
    student_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    direction_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    self_assessed_experience VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    known_stacks TEXT[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    desired_stacks TEXT[] NOT NULL,
    goal_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    goal_text VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    preferred_language VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
    weekly_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL,
    preferred_pace VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    profile_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    version BIGINT NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT ck_student_onboarding_weekly_minutes CHECK (weekly_minutes BETWEEN 15 AND 10080),
    CONSTRAINT ck_student_onboarding_known_stacks CHECK (cardinality(known_stacks) <= 20),
    CONSTRAINT ck_student_onboarding_desired_stacks CHECK (cardinality(desired_stacks) BETWEEN 1 AND 20),
    CONSTRAINT ck_student_onboarding_version CHECK (version >= 1),
    CONSTRAINT ck_student_onboarding_time CHECK (updated_at >= created_at)
);
